stem: The diagram shows how a ray of light behaves when it strikes a surface.
instruction: This question has two parts. First, answer Part A. Then answer Part B.

options.label: A
options.text: Arrow W and Arrow X show light refracting as it interacts with the surface.

options.label: B
options.text: Arrow W and Arrow Y show light refracting as it interacts with the surface.

options.label: C
options.text: Arrow Y and Arrow Z show light reflecting as it interacts with the surface.

options.label: D
options.text: Arrow W and Arrow Z show light reflecting as it interacts with the surface.

visual_elements: Diagram labeled with a flashlight pointing a ray labeled W hitting a surface. Arrows X, Y, and Z show directions of light. X goes up and right away from surface. Y goes down into surface. Z goes downward and right away from surface.
notes: Includes Part A and Part B with each having four answer options.
